executive_summary: NWO call within the National Growth Fund programme 'Self-thinking Molecular Systems' (Big Chemistry) for proof-of-concept research that combines experimental chemistry, automation and AI in three research lines: foams and emulsions; coatings, adhesives and inks; and drug-delivery systems. The main applicant must be a researcher at a Dutch research organisation; enterprises and civil society organisations with R&D in the Netherlands may be co-applicants (funded at 40% of eligible costs), cooperation partners or co-funders. A consortium needs at least a main applicant and a co-funder, with co-funding of at least 20% of the grant (at least half in cash, of private origin). Total budget EUR 2,550,421; at most EUR 400,000 grant per project, NWO funds at most 80% of the total project size, and projects last at most 30 months. Single-stage deadline: 23 February 2027, 14:00 CET.
status_rationale: The call funds proof-of-concept research that uses AI and high-throughput experiments to predict and optimise the properties of complex molecular systems for the chemical industry, in the research lines foams and emulsions, coatings/adhesives/inks and drug-delivery systems (Call for proposals NGF Big Chemistry 2026, section 2.1 Aim of the programme and 2.2 Background). It does not touch TenneT's field: AI is applied only to chemical formulation, the call names no application in energy, grids or infrastructure, and the nearest project file (Impressed Current Cathodic Corrosion Protection) concerns asset maintenance offshore, which a generic coatings-formulation research line does not address.
